links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of chatbot fibromyalgia responses
links.effect: ChatGPT responses required lower reading grade levels; Gemini produced more complex responses requiring higher reading levels; DeepSeek fell mid-range. No numeric grade levels reported in abstract.
links.quote: Readability analysis using the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level revealed that ChatGPT's responses generally required lower reading grade levels, making them more accessible.

screen.reason: Evaluates medical accuracy and readability of three LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) answering patient questions about fibromyalgia.
